# Local vision verification fixtures

`one.jpg`: NASA photograph of astronaut Eileen Collins, obtained from scikit-image
v0.25.2 `astronaut.png`. Converted to JPEG. Public domain, no known copyright restrictions.
[Published source and rights](https://scikit-image.org/docs/stable/api/skimage.data#skimage.data.astronaut).

`two.jpg`: two resized copies of that NASA photograph, placed side by side on a
640×400 background. This is a synthetic two-person composition for detector
verification, not a real two-person camera recording. Public domain source.

`phone.jpg`: Olaf Simons, *Image created with a mobile phone.png*, 10 January 2013.
[Original and attribution](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Image_created_with_a_mobile_phone.png).
Licensed [CC BY-SA 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/).
This derivative is resized to 640×480 and converted to JPEG and is distributed
under the same CC BY-SA 3.0 license. The photograph's license applies to this
image, not to the surrounding application code. No endorsement is implied.

These are public, labelled development fixtures. Candidate frames are never
stored here or anywhere else on disk by the vision pipeline.
